verdict.rationale: Stagehand is itself an official SDK. Its docs claim support across TypeScript, Python, and Go, and explicitly name a 'Stagehand Python SDK' that the CrewAI tool wraps. Building against it is backed by a quickstart, API reference pages, and AI-assistant coding rules for writing correct v4 code. Missing for 10: per-language depth for Go and Python (evidence centers on general v4 docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration specific to the multi-language SDKs.
